title: Kerala's BEVCO records liquor sales worth ₹233 crore in three days ahead of Onam
content: Thiruvananthapuram: In a remarkable surge ahead of the Onam festive season, liquor sales in Kerala have scaled new heights, recording a massive turnover of 232.99 crore in just three days. Between 18 and 20 August, the state-run Kerala State Beverages Corporation (BEVCO) outlets witnessed unprecedented demand, reflecting the grand scale of festive celebrations across the state. A massive spike in revenue According to official data, the revenue of 232.99 crore marks a significant increase of 23.1 crore compared to the corresponding festive period last year. During the first three days of the Onam season last year, BEVCO registered liquor sales of 209.89 crore. This year's remarkable growth highlight soaring consumer spending during Kerala's most celebrated cultural festival. BEVCO outlets lead the charge State-owned retail outlets across Kerala reported an intense rush during these three days as people stocked up for the holidays. BEVCO, which holds a monopoly over the distribution and retail sale of liquor in Kerala, had put in place extensive arrangements to manage the heavy footfall and ensure hassle-free service at all key locations.
